lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice summarizing healthcare follow-up advice and expressing uncertainty appropriately.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Understanding advice after a healthcare visit and deciding when to seek follow-up.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Restating advice, identifying a condition, and hedging uncertainty about next steps.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss follow-up advice after a vårdcentral visit, focusing on rest, symptoms, and when to call again.

main_focus.name: hedged interpretation with det verkar som att
main_focus.description: Use cautious interpretation language when summarizing advice and deciding whether action is needed.
model_examples: Det verkar som att vila är viktigast de första dagarna.
Om symtomen blir värre bör man ringa igen.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use hedged interpretation naturally 3-4 times, with 2-3 conditional follow-up sentences.

useful_chunks: Jag är lite osäker på om...
Då är det bättre att ringa igen.
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use practical healthcare-service vocabulary without giving medical advice.

dialogue_shape.opening: Follow-up advice from a healthcare visit is introduced.
dialogue_shape.middle: They summarize the main advice, discuss a condition for calling again, and express uncertainty carefully.
dialogue_shape.ending: They agree on what to monitor and when to contact the vårdcentral.

target_complexity.repetition: hedging and condition phrases should make the advice sound careful

focus: the condition that would require further contact
the agreed plan for monitoring the situation

sentence_focus: one sentence reporting advice with enligt
one sentence with det verkar som att
one sentence with om symtomen blir värre
one sentence stating when to call again
